verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover running quantized models (FP8/INT4) and serving inference via vLLM/SGLang, which are the software pieces needed for large-LLM inference. A community commenter puts memory bandwidth at about 3.7TB/s from 8 HBM2e stacks, comparable to the H100. However, the pack never states VRAM capacity and never shows a 70B-class model fitting or running on a single card or node. missing for 10: published HBM/VRAM capacity figure, first-party bandwidth spec, documented or hands-on 70B-class quantized inference on a single node.
